Status.description: The `Status` type defines a logical error model that is suitable for different programming environments, including REST APIs and RPC APIs. It is used by [gRPC](https://github.com/grpc). Each `Status` message contains three pieces of data: error code, error message, and error details. You can find out more about this error model and how to work with it in the [API Design Guide](https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/errors).

ListEndpointsResponse.description: Message for response to listing Endpoints

endpoints.description: The list of Endpoint resources matching the parent and filter criteria in the request. Each Endpoint resource follows the format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/endpoints/{endpoint}`.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results the server should return. Used in page_token.

SearchMcpServersResponse.description: Message for response to searching MCP Servers

nextPageToken.description: If there are more results than those appearing in this response, then `next_page_token` is included. To get the next set of results, call this method again using the value of `next_page_token` as `page_token`.

mcpServers.description: A list of McpServers that match the `search_string`.

endpointId.description: Output only. A stable, globally unique identifier for Endpoint.

displayName.description: Output only. Display name for the Endpoint.

attributes.description: Output only. Attributes of the Endpoint. Valid values: * `agentregistry.googleapis.com/system/RuntimeReference`: {"uri": "//..."} - the URI of the underlying resource hosting the Endpoint, for example, the GKE Deployment.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the Endpoint. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/endpoints/{endpoint}`.

interfaces.description: Required. The connection details for the Endpoint.

description.description: Output only. Description of an Endpoint.

Agent.description: Represents an Agent. "A2A" below refers to the Agent-to-Agent protocol.

protocols.description: Output only. The connection details for the Agent.

skills.description: Output only. Skills the agent possesses, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card.

description.description: Output only. The description of the Agent, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card. Empty if Agent Card has no description.

uid.description: Output only. A universally unique identifier for the Agent.

displayName.description: Output only. The display name of the agent, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card.

location.description: Output only. The location where agent is hosted. The value is defined by the hosting environment (i.e. cloud provider).

agentId.description: Output only. A stable, globally unique identifier for agents.

card.description: Output only. Full Agent Card payload, when available.

version.description: Output only. The version of the Agent, often obtained from the A2A Agent Card. Empty if Agent Card has no version or agent is not an A2A Agent.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of an Agent. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/agents/{agent}`.

attributes.description: Output only. Attributes of the Agent. Valid values: * `agentregistry.googleapis.com/system/Framework`: {"framework": "google-adk"} - the agent framework used to develop the Agent. Example values: "google-adk", "langchain", "custom". * `agentregistry.googleapis.com/system/RuntimeIdentity`: {"principal": "principal://..."} - the runtime identity associated with the Agent. * `agentregistry.googleapis.com/system/RuntimeReference`: {"uri": "//..."} - the URI of the underlying resource hosting the Agent, for example, the Reasoning Engine URI.

identifier.description: The identifier of the target Agent, MCP Server, or Endpoint. Format: * `urn:agent:{publisher}:{namespace}:{name}` * `urn:mcp:{publisher}:{namespace}:{name}` * `urn:endpoint:{publisher}:{namespace}:{name}`
